second_answer_attack.resolution: SCN5A can cause conduction disease, but the stem specifies NKX2-5 and a familial ASD-plus-AV-block phenotype. NKX2-5 encodes a cardiac homeobox transcription factor, not a sodium channel.

item.tested_construct: TBX5 encodes a T-box transcription factor required for coordinated development of the upper limbs and heart. Haploinsufficiency disrupts radial-ray development and cardiac septation/conduction, producing the characteristic heart-hand phenotype.

blind_audit.rationale: NKX2-5 encodes a homeobox-containing transcription factor that is critical for heart formation and development. Pathogenic variants are a recognized cause of atrial septal defects with atrioventricular conduction disease. Strongest alternative resolved: SCN5A can cause conduction disease, but the stem specifies NKX2-5 and a familial ASD-plus-AV-block phenotype. NKX2-5 encodes a cardiac homeobox transcription factor, not a sodium channel.
